status: development-only draft; not a preregistration or test freeze
purpose: Develop and evaluate an anytime pair-search improvement against exact pair search and a published-specification ME-GA reimplementation, with physics resolution checked before method selection.

inheritance_and_limits.matched_v1_status: The local V1 report records a completed one-shot held-out evaluation. V1 results are prior knowledge, not a source for V2 method tuning outcomes.
inheritance_and_limits.legacy_method_naming: Method IDs ending in _ga in matched_v1 denote ranked ILS hybrids, not population genetic algorithms.
inheritance_and_limits.memory_ga: A memory-guided ILS adaptation inspired by Zardi et al.; not a faithful reproduction or the published-spec ME-GA comparator.
inheritance_and_limits.novelty: No novelty claim is authorized by this development config. Recheck the exact frozen combination against current literature before any claim.

development.use: All search design, profiling, C1 diagnosis, ablations, budget feasibility and method selection.

fine_mesh_validation.use: Initial mesh-resolution diagnostics only; this existing subset has 3 trajectories and is insufficient by itself to establish a general mesh-error bound.

held_out_test.use: One final evaluation after a separate canonical matched_v2.json, source/checkpoint hashes, contrasts, margin and budget have been frozen.
prohibited_before_freeze: Do not run controllers, score actions, derive labels, or use rates/SNRs/trace outcomes for method, hyperparameter, margin or budget selection.
Do not reopen the test to retune or select a fallback budget. Report held-out misses at the locked budget as failures.

data.scope: Simulation-only coupled two-user, fixed-precoder, worst-user-rate control on the declared NEC-2 multiport model; no held-out environment claim.

execution.cpu_affinity: core 3; one benchmark process at a time; single-thread numerical libraries
execution.budget_selection_rule: On development data, choose the smallest registered budget with zero deadline misses across every included method, seed and frame. If no listed budget is feasible, do not make a deadline-bounded superiority claim. Record the chosen budget in the canonical frozen protocol before any test outcome is inspected.
execution.test_miss_rule: A miss on the held-out test is reported at the frozen budget; it cannot trigger reselection or fallback using test outcomes.
execution.seed_policy: Use the same ten seeds for every method and development trajectory; final test uses the same seed list after freeze. Seeds are repeated stochastic runs, not independent sampling units.

critical_path.name: ME-GA baseline and review
critical_path.gate: Implement and independently review me_ga and ga_risc as published-specification reimplementations; document all operator and memory assumptions the paper leaves unspecified. Keep me_ga_paper as a separate full-budget profile, never label it a deadline-matched run.

critical_path.name: Physics-resolution gate
critical_path.gate: The validation-only C1 audit is complete and rejects 81-segment scores for V2 optimizer claims: 5,450/5,760 returned actions exceeded 0.015 bit/s/Hz under 81-to-161 refinement, and 14.1466% of non-tied pairwise rankings reversed. Use 161-segment scores as the V2 development reference. The audit covers three validation trajectories and does not establish that 161 segments are converged. Specify a separate mesh-convergence criterion and engineering margin before any improvement claim; do not inherit 0.015 bit/s/Hz as a general mesh bound.

critical_path.name: Incremental anytime pair-search ladder
critical_path.gate: Implement one step at a time after C1; compare each step with its immediate predecessor on the 30 development trajectories using paired trajectory-level outcomes. Do not advance a component that fails the predeclared development criterion.

critical_path.name: Freeze and one-shot V2 test
critical_path.gate: After the ladder and fine-mesh gate, freeze the exact method, configuration, checkpoint/source/data hashes, contrast family, practical margin and feasible budget in a new canonical matched_v2.json. Then run the 30-trajectory test once and audit all returned primary-budget actions on the preselected fine-mesh evaluator.

separate_reporting: me_ga_paper: full published Gamma-by-V workload and actual elapsed time; not a matched-deadline contrast
geometry-informed binary RIS method: include only if its objective assumptions transfer; otherwise document why it is inapplicable, not as a baseline
methods.scope_notes: The exact frozen method IDs and final contrast family remain unresolved until implementation and development gates pass. Keep single-flip and diagonal-Z rescoring as separate diagnostic/physics contrasts.

ladder.change: Anytime ILS: continue ranked variants until the deadline rather than stopping after a short fixed search.
ladder.testable_reason: Existing V1 validation traces suggest ranked variants can stop well before their allotted budget; quantify this before making an efficiency claim.

ladder.change: Screened restarts: perform inexpensive single-flip descent first and spend full pair-scan work only on promising basins.
ladder.testable_reason: Measure restarts completed, scoring cost and final rate; no gain is assumed.

ladder.change: Compare uniform, prespecified density-based and elite-derived restart distributions.
ladder.testable_reason: Use development trajectories only; tune distribution parameters inside the development split and freeze them before test.

ladder.change: Add a deterministic escape from the all-OFF two-opt trap, such as tabu or best non-improving pair moves with a fixed tie-break.
ladder.testable_reason: Measure all-OFF return frequency and rate without selecting the rule from test outcomes.

ladder.change: Add one elite recombination method (crossover or path relinking), selected on development evidence.
ladder.testable_reason: Charge construction and scoring to the complete deadline; retain only if it improves the preceding frozen step.

ladder.change: Add cross-frame elite memory with exact rescoring and Woodbury updates.
ladder.testable_reason: Reset memory at trajectory boundaries; compare with identical inputs and runtime accounting.

physics_gate.status: 81-segment coarse objective rejected for V2 method claims; use 161-segment reference; convergence pending

c1_validation_evidence.conclusion: The 81-segment objective is numerically unresolved for V2 optimizer claims. Use 161-segment scores as the V2 development reference; 161-segment convergence itself remains unestablished. This is validation-only sensitivity evidence, not a held-out test audit or universal mesh bound.

physics_gate.margin_rule: Do not inherit 0.015 bit/s/Hz as a general mesh bound or V2 margin. C1 shows the 81-segment objective is numerically unresolved; use 161-segment scores as the V2 development reference. The 161-segment convergence criterion and any practical decision margin remain pending a separate predeclared convergence/engineering design. Withhold an improvement claim until that design supports it.
physics_gate.test_action_audit: Preselect the fine-mesh rule before scoring test actions; audit every primary-budget returned action from every included method, seed, frame and held-out trajectory. Record action count, mesh hashes, maximum absolute rate shift and criterion result.

outcomes.primary: Mean worst-user spectral efficiency in bit/s/Hz at the frozen feasible primary budget, after full objective recomputation; paired method differences are averaged within trajectory.
secondary: p95 complete runtime, including preparation, feature extraction, inference, memory operations and objective scoring
deadline-miss count and rate, retaining misses in the report
objective-candidate evaluations and time-to-target; descriptive only unless separately frozen
best-known gap and component profiling on development trajectories
outcomes.counting: Count each actual objective candidate score once. Do not count neural inference as an objective evaluation; include its time in complete runtime.

statistics.independent_unit: trajectory; average paired seeds and frames within trajectory before resampling
statistics.intervals: Paired trajectory bootstrap; Bonferroni simultaneous percentile intervals across the frozen contrast family. The ladder-stage family and final confirmatory family must be enumerated before their respective decisions.
statistics.p_values: If reported, use a centered paired-bootstrap zero-null test and Holm-adjust p-values separately; do not derive intervals from Holm-adjusted p-values.
statistics.limits: Development decisions are exploratory. Small independent trajectory counts, exchangeability assumptions and trajectory-specific generalization limit inference; seeds and frames do not inflate n.
statistics.decision_rule: No numerical improved/equivalent/deteriorated classification until the margin and final contrast family are frozen after C1.

freeze_checklist: C1 fine-mesh diagnostics reviewed; margin and resolution criterion numeric and source-backed
L1-L6 development ladder complete or stopped by its predeclared rule
ME-GA reimplementation and GA-RISC assumptions reviewed independently
Exact final method, step sequence, search config, training inputs and checkpoint hashes fixed
All 10 paired seeds, 30 test trajectories, primary budget, contrast family, metrics and mesh audit rules frozen in canonical matched_v2.json
V2 test remains unscored and unopened for outcome-based decisions before freeze
